title: Slicing Axes-Parallel Rectangles
statement: Let us say that two rectangles in the place are independent if both their $x$- and $y$-axis projections are disjoint. A set of rectangles is then independent if the rectangles are pairwise independent. Suppose that a collection of axes-parallel rectangles contains no independent set of size $m$ or greater. What is the minimal number, $f(m)$, of horizontal and vertical lines needed to slice every rectangle in the collection?
